model.backbone: Audit → Diagnose → Team design → Manual delivery → Systematise → Install → Maintain
model.lede: The dashboard is the visible surface. The product itself is this operating model — a system Maxpromo installs into a business.

audit.name: Audit
audit.purpose: Look through the business: where time is lost, where customers wait, where leads leak, what still runs by hand.
audit.pain: No clear picture of where the business loses time, customers and oversight.
audit.handoff: The findings go into the diagnosis.

diagnose.name: Diagnosis
diagnose.purpose: Turn audit findings into concrete operational pain points.
diagnose.pain: The symptoms are visible; the cause and the cost are not.
diagnose.output: A diagnosis list with impact and the recommended stage.
diagnose.handoff: The diagnosis decides which agent team is needed.

design.name: Agent team design
design.purpose: Recommend which agents the business needs — from the Chief of Staff alone to the full bureau.
design.pain: It is not clear what support is actually needed.
design.output: An agent recommendation that fits the situation.
design.handoff: The team goes into manual delivery.

manual_delivery.name: Manual delivery
manual_delivery.purpose: Serve the first customers by hand while the platform grows.
manual_delivery.pain: Value has to be delivered before everything is automated.
manual_delivery.output: Implementation notes and approved agent tasks.

systemize.name: Systematisation
systemize.purpose: Turn repeated manual work into reusable playbooks and workflows.
systemize.pain: The same work is done by hand again and again.
systemize.output: Reusable playbooks, templates and approval rules.

install.name: Installation
install.purpose: Install the AI Chief of Staff and the agent bureau into the business.
install.pain: The business needs an installed, controlled system — not a tool to assemble itself.
install.output: A configuration installed, handed over and supervised.

maintain.name: Maintenance
maintain.purpose: Running it: monitoring, updates, customer-specific configuration, improvements.
maintain.pain: Systems decay without care; this is not a one-off project.
maintain.output: Health checks, audit logs and monthly recommendations.
maintain.handoff: New findings start the cycle again.

hierarchy_.chief-of-staff: The coordinating intelligence: prioritises, coordinates, routes approvals, watches the audit trail.
hierarchy_.research-agent: Watches the market, the competition and the sector.
hierarchy_.crm-agent: Follow-ups, deal movement, keeping relationships warm.
hierarchy_.calendar-agent: Proposed meetings, reminders, the shape of the day.
hierarchy_.operations-agent: Project and task tracking, and visibility of the process.
hierarchy_.document-agent: Document summaries, quotations, pulling out what matters.
hierarchy_.follow-up-agent: Spots waiting customers and prepares the next step.

chief-of-staff.description: Prioritises the work, produces the daily briefing, coordinates the other agents and puts decisions up for approval.
capDescs: Judges what needs attention today.
Sums up the situation, the risks and the next steps.
Sends work to the agent that handles it.
chief-of-staff.next: Have the 08:00 briefing ready for review.

lead-agent.description: Researches companies, finds contacts, fills in records and qualifies incoming enquiries.
capDescs: Collects public information about a prospect.
Fills the gaps in a contact record.
Judges fit and urgency.
blocked: Exporting data to a third party
lead-agent.next: Qualify the new audit enquiry from Essen.

research-agent.description: Watches the market, the competition and sector signals, and reports what is worth acting on.
capDescs: Tracks movement in the topics it has been given.
Condenses what it finds into short briefs.

crm-agent.description: Tracks deals, raises follow-ups that are due and keeps contact data current.
capDescs: Spots the follow-ups that are due.
Flags stale or duplicated records.
allowed: Propose a correction to a record
blocked: Sending a message to a customer
crm-agent.next: Put three overdue follow-ups up for approval.

calendar-agent.description: Proposes meetings, raises reminders and keeps the calendar tidy.
capDescs: Finds a slot that works.
Points at what is coming up.
calendar-agent.next: Propose a slot for the audit conversation.

content-agent.description: Plans content, writes drafts and prepares campaigns — for review, never for publishing.
capDescs: Sketches the topics and the schedule.
Writes first drafts for review.
content-agent.next: Put the case-study post draft up for review.

operations-agent.description: Tracks projects, tasks and deadlines, and raises a blockage early.
capDescs: Keeps an eye on progress and deadlines.
Flags risks and blockages.
blocked: Reassigning someone else's work without approval

document-agent.description: Writes and structures documents — quotations, reports, summaries — for approval.
capDescs: Drafts a structured document.
Pulls the substance out of a source document.
outcomes: A clear next action on every document
document-agent.next: Prepare the quotation draft for the new enquiry.

follow-up-agent.description: Makes sure no opportunity and no promise gets lost — and prepares the next chase.
capDescs: Finds open promises and threads that went quiet.
Drafts the next chase.
blocked: Sending a message on its own
follow-up-agent.next: Put five quiet threads up to be chased.
